newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian shares close higher, TISCO in limelight.
newsitem.headline: Indian shares close higher, TISCO in limelight.

text.p: ** (1230 GMT) - Blue-chips end with minor gains
** TISCO jumps 4.5 pct at Bombay bourse in hectic trade
** Speculators active players in the stock--traders
** Bombay's benchmark index closes 11.81 pts, or 0.36 pct,
higher at 3,264.12 in range-bound trade
** Delhi index rises 7.18 pts, Calcutta index up 3.41 pts
to 431.22, but Madras index off 6.64 pts to 3,186.38
** National bourse index gains 1.0 point to 928.80
Stocks at Indian bourses finished with minor gains on Tuesday as a lack of market-moving factors limited price movement in the broader market, dealers said.

Shares of Tata Iron & Steel Company Ltd. (TISCO) were in focus on the back of heavy speculative action. TISCO rose 8.25 rupees, or 4.5 percent, to 189.75, off its intra-day high of 190.50 at the Bombay Stock Exchange (BSE).
"TISCO was the major market mover today...there appears to be quite a lot of speculative pressure," said Piyush Vora, a member-broker of the BSE.
Aggressive bidding by speculators accompanied by some foreign fund buying helped the share to climb to higher levels, dealers said.
TISCO topped the list of the most heavily traded shares.
With more than 7.41 million shares changing hands, TISCO displaced SBI as the top traded stock at the BSE. SBI rose 6.0 rupees to 247.75 in volumes of over five million shares.
"It is quite rare to see the stock topping the list of most actively traded shares at the BSE," Vora said.
At the rival National Stock Exchange (NSE), TISCO surged 6.20 rupees to end at 187.10 in volumes of 12.2 million shares.
Market participants said foreign funds were keeping a low profile and were scattered buyers in pivotal stocks.

ACC fell 1.75 rupees to 1,288.0, ITC 3.0 to 323.0, TELCO 4.50 to 349.0, MTNL 3.0 to 227.25 and Gujarat Ambuja Cement 1.0 to 259.0. Reliance, however, advanced 3.0 to 219.0, M&M 5.50 to 352.50 and Sterlite 7.50 to 228.25.
The BSE's key 30-share index ended with a net gain of 11.81 points, or 0.36 percent, at 3,264.12, off its intra-day high of 3,273.43.
-- ANSHUMAN DAGA, Bombay newsroom +91-22-265 9000
